# Spytrend

> Spytrend is an advertising analytics platform. It covers advertising from Meta
> and TikTok and lets you see not one placement at a time but everything a single
> account runs — every ad, video, page, domain, country and run date at once.
> It connects to AI assistants over the Model Context Protocol.

One ad is a single frame. This shows the whole body of work.

Endpoint: https://mcp.spytrend.com/mcp — Streamable HTTP, browser sign-in with a
Spytrend account. Nothing to install, no key to paste. The connection is available
on every plan, though the free plan is limited to the archive — nothing from the last 90 days.
Usage is metered in tokens from one balance and you pay for results,
not for asking: a call that returns nothing costs nothing. Ask get_usage — it is
free and it answers from the server.

Ads can be filtered by country, business category, format and run dates.
Advertising is sorted into business categories — home services, beauty, games,
finance, education and so on — so you can look at your own niche instead of
everything at once.

## Connect

- [Connection page](https://spytrend.com/mcp/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=repo&utm_campaign=mcp-launch): endpoint, sign-in and per-client setup
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/Spytrend/spytrend-mcp/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): connecting in five minutes, per client
- [Repository](https://github.com/Spytrend/spytrend-mcp): connection passport, tool reference and recipes

## Tools

- [Tool reference](https://github.com/Spytrend/spytrend-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools.md): every documented tool, when to use it and when not to
- Search: `search_ads`, `search_creatives`, `search_advertisers`, `search_webmasters`, `search_hubs`, `search_shops`
- One record in full: `get_ad`, `get_advertiser`, `get_webmaster`, `get_creative`, `get_shop`
- Download: `get_media` — the image or video file itself
- Rankings: `get_trends`
- Look-alikes: `find_similar_ads`, `find_similar_creatives`, `find_similar_webmasters`, `get_webmaster_similarity_facets`
- Folders and balance: `add_to_favorites`, `list_favorites`, `get_usage`
- Twenty-one advertising tools. Costs are in the tool reference; `get_usage` always answers from the server.
- Startups (Startups Business plan, billed in Startups objects, not tokens): `search_startups`, `get_startup`, `compare_startups`, `lookup_startup`, `enrich_startups`, `search_funding_rounds`, `search_investors`, `get_investor`, `search_startup_news`, `get_startup_ads`, `get_startup_ads_growth`, `create_company_report`, `retry_company_report`, `cancel_company_report`, `list_company_reports`, `get_company_report`. 1 object per row, 5 per company card, 25,000 objects a month; ordering a company report takes 1 of the monthly company-report allowance (5 on Business) and no objects, beyond it 150 balance tokens per company only with the user's consent (`allow_paid`); cancelling and reading your own reports is free. `estimate_cost` (free) prices a call before it is made. A missing figure is unknown, never zero.

## Recipes

- [Find competitors](https://github.com/Spytrend/spytrend-mcp/blob/main/examples/find-competitors.md): who else is advertising in your market, and what they run
- [Match to a business type](https://github.com/Spytrend/spytrend-mcp/blob/main/examples/by-business-type.md): advertising from businesses like yours, no competitor names needed
- [Top of a niche](https://github.com/Spytrend/spytrend-mcp/blob/main/examples/top-of-niche.md): what is running in a category, by how long it has been up
- [What is running now](https://github.com/Spytrend/spytrend-mcp/blob/main/examples/running-now.md): what is new and picking up in an industry

## Skills

- [Skills](https://github.com/Spytrend/spytrend-mcp/tree/main/skills): seven ready-made workflows for Claude Code and Codex — vertical intelligence, advertiser overview, webmaster overview, website review, keyword search, shop discovery, startup research. Plain folders; copy into the assistant's skills directory.
- [Connection manual for agents](https://mcp.spytrend.com/llms.txt): token flow, per-client connection paths, access and billing, straight from the server.
